notes: Major code SE27 (non-specialized). Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu and the department major-requirements page. Students complete all core requirements plus one of the four focus sequences (civil, aerospace, geotechnical, or SHM/NDE) in full with the matching capstone; the focus sequence does not appear on the diploma for SE27. Minimum 145 units plus college GE.

buckets.label: Mathematics sequence
buckets.note: All six required. Confirmed on both pages.

buckets.label: Physics sequence
buckets.note: All required (2B/2BL and 2C/2CL are lecture+lab pairs). Confirmed.

buckets.label: Introductory Structural Engineering
buckets.note: SE 1, SE 3, and SE 9 all confirmed on BOTH the general catalog and the current department major-requirements page. Prior harvest note about SE 9 being omitted on the department page is outdated.

buckets.label: Upper-division core
buckets.note: All 13 required for every SE major. Confirmed exactly on both pages.

buckets.label: Focus sequence (choose one, complete in full)
buckets.note: Complete ONE full focus sequence: Civil (SE 103, 150A, 151A, 181); Aerospace (SE 142, 160A, 160B, 171); Geotechnical (SE 151A, 181, 182, 184); SHM/NDE (SE 163, 164, 167, 168). All course lists confirmed against catalog.

buckets.label: Capstone / senior design
buckets.note: Capstone matching the chosen focus: Civil & Geotech = SE 140A + 140B; Aerospace = SE 143A + 143B; SHM/NDE = SE 165 (single design course, taken with one additional technical elective per the catalog).

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: 3 preapproved upper-division/graduate technical electives outside the focus sequence. SE 195, SE 197, and SE 198 are not allowed; SE 199 only under restricted conditions. Confirmed.

buckets.label: General education
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units in arts, humanities, and social sciences plus college GE requirements. Confirmed. Engineering-major GE bucket. Per the UCSD catalog SE-ug page, the SE major requires a minimum of 24 units in the arts, humanities, and social sciences (excluding accounting, industrial management, finance, personnel administration), satisfied via the student's college general-education program. Specific qualifying courses depend on the student's college (Revelle/Muir/Marshall/Warren/Roosevelt/Sixth/Seventh), so this is covered by the college GE section rather than a fixed major course list.

buckets.label: Total program units
buckets.note: Minimum 145 units plus college GE requirements. Confirmed. Unit-count requirement only: minimum 145 units for the major, plus college general-education requirements in humanities and social sciences. Confirmed on catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/SE-ug.html ('a minimum of 145 units, plus college general-education requirements').
